modules.title: 生产流量怎样从蓝色环境切到绿色环境
两套环境解决什么问题

items.title: 候选版本不会原地覆盖正在服务的版本
items.text: 蓝色环境继续运行 v1 时，团队在独立的绿色环境部署并检查 v2。绿色环境失败不会直接覆盖蓝色应用；只有登录、预订和健康检查通过后，生产入口才改变指向。

items.title: 切流以后仍要验证并保留退路
items.text: 入口切到绿色环境后，要确认实际运行版本和关键指标；蓝色环境暂时保留，异常时才能快速切回。何时删除旧环境取决于观察期、资源成本和数据是否仍允许旧版运行。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 蓝绿部署的核心是两套完整环境和一次生产流量切换；金丝雀发布则先把少量真实流量分给新版，再逐步扩大。蓝绿部署也不自动复制或回滚数据库、会话和外部服务，破坏性数据变更会让“切回蓝色”失效。

lessonPractice.title: 绿色环境 v2 已通过页面检查，但它执行了旧版 v1 无法读取的数据库变更。现在应该怎样做？

options.label: 先解决数据向前向后兼容和回退方案，再决定是否切生产流量
options.feedback: 对。应用流量能切回蓝色环境，不代表旧版还能读取已经变化的数据。

options.label: 直接切到绿色环境，因为蓝绿部署本身保证随时可以回退
options.feedback: 蓝绿部署只提供环境和流量切换能力，不能自动保证数据结构兼容。

options.label: 切流前先删除蓝色环境，避免两套环境占用资源
options.feedback: 过早删除蓝色环境会失去快速切回路径，也违背本次蓝绿部署的止损目标。

en.title: Green v2 passes page checks, but it applies a database change that old blue v1 cannot read. What should happen now?

options.label: Resolve forward and backward data compatibility and the recovery plan before switching production traffic
options.feedback: Correct. Traffic can return to blue, but the old application may not understand data already changed by v2.

options.label: Switch immediately because blue-green guarantees rollback
options.feedback: Blue-green provides environments and traffic switching; it does not make schema changes automatically compatible.

options.label: Delete blue before switching to avoid running two environments
options.feedback: Deleting blue too early removes the quick return path and defeats the mitigation goal.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为旅游站 v2 做蓝绿部署：蓝色 v1 保持生产服务，在绿色环境部署并验证登录和预订。检查数据兼容后再切生产流量；切换后确认实际版本、错误率和预订成功率，并暂时保留蓝色环境用于回退。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Blue-green deploy travel site v2: keep blue v1 serving production while deploying and verifying login and booking on green. Check data compatibility before switching traffic; afterward confirm the live version, error rate, and booking success, and temporarily retain blue for return.

references.title: Azure Container Apps 中的蓝绿部署
references.title_en: Blue-green deployment in Azure Container Apps

learning.assumes: You know deployment places a version in an environment and an entry routes requests to it.
learning.outcome: You can identify both environments, the switch gate, post-switch evidence, and the data boundary for a safe return.

modules.title: How production traffic switches from blue to green

items.title: The candidate does not overwrite the serving release in place
items.text: While blue keeps v1 live, the team deploys and checks v2 in an independent green environment. A failed green does not overwrite blue; the production entry changes only after login, booking, and health checks pass.

items.title: Verify after switching and keep a return path
items.text: After routing to green, confirm the live version and key signals. Retain blue temporarily so traffic can return on anomaly. The observation period, resource cost, and data compatibility determine when the old environment can be removed.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Blue-green centers on two full environments and a production traffic switch; a canary sends only a small amount of real traffic to the new release before expansion. Blue-green also does not automatically copy or restore databases, sessions, or external services. A destructive data change can make switching back to blue unsafe.

distinctions.label: Canary release
distinctions.text: {c:blue-green-deployment} validates a second production-capable environment before switching the entry. A {c:canary-release} first sends a small share of real production traffic to the new release.
